# Python runtime license notices

Unmodified license texts from [python-build-standalone 20260325](https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/tree/20260325). The bundled CPython 3.14.3 runtime uses this build. The set includes optional upstream components as well as those used by this app. `manifest.json` records origins and SHA-256 hashes.

The runtime and its Python license are preserved in the app bundle. Fenlet does not modify CPython.
